title: Precise words replace an unlimited promise

captions.physics: Directly thanking for an inaccuracy named
captions.energy: Ending an exhausted unlimited promise formula
captions.emotions: Feeling significance in words genuinely accepted

meaning: You can directly thank each other for an inaccuracy named and end an exhausted unlimited promise, feeling significance in words genuinely accepted without requiring eternal infallibility.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Sun in the physical position appears in direct warm thanks for an inaccuracy named. Death in energy supports readiness to end an exhausted form of unlimited promising. The Hierophant in emotions brings significance to words genuinely accepted. You can take a correction seriously without promising to exclude every future mistake. Ending concerns a verbal formula rather than removing the value of actual commitments.

For example, after a sharp remark comes “Thank you for saying which word hurt”. Instead of a general “I will never say anything like that again”, you can directly name the phrase genuinely unacceptable within this exchange. **Words gain weight without a promise of complete infallibility**. Respect for agreement remains without an unlimited vow. Leaving a general formula proves no insincere apology; understood substance matters rather than an impressive quantity promised or readiness forever to exclude every difficult feeling.

Difficulty arises if precise words are still measured against the earlier unlimited demand: every awkwardness supposedly breaches the whole agreement. A limited actual commitment loses meaning again. Constructive Death energy helps leave the exhausted measure and distinguish particular acceptance from an unknown future. You can respect a promise and separately discuss another unsuccessful remark; seriousness requires neither treating every mistake identically nor restoring an impossible vow to feel order finally recovered.
